attributes.name: Adamantine Bullets
attributes.powers:
Display this card; you may not do so during an encounter. After playing this card, if you have more than 2 cards that have the Ammunition trait displayed, recharge 1 of them.

While displayed, when you play a weapon that has the Firearm trait on your combat check against a monster that has an effect that increases the difficulty of that check, you may discard this card to ignore that effect. You may succeed at a Craft 9 check to recharge this card instead of discarding it.

corrections.corrected_text: On the items Adamantine Bullets, Alchemical Cartridges, Blessed Bullet, Dragonbreath Shot, Entangling Shot, Flare Shot, Poisoned Bullets, and Shock Bullets, change "Display this card; you may not play this card during an encounter" to "Display this card; you may not do so during an encounter".
corrections.issue: Can displayed Ammunitions be played during an encounter?
